resources.string: Speccy OS uses the Accessibility API to detect when an emulator closes and to let the physical Menu/Select buttons open the control panel over your games. We do not collect or share personal data.
Lets the physical gamepad buttons open the Speccy OS quick panel.
Speccy OS needs the Accessibility Service to intercept your handheld\'s physical buttons and bring you back to the dashboard when you leave a game.\n\nNo screen content is read or stored.
To index your game library and download box art and preview videos, Speccy OS needs permission to read and write your storage.
Speccy OS lists your installed apps so it can launch your games straight into emulators such as RetroArch, Dolphin or AetherSX2.
This lets Speccy OS show its quick menu on top of your games so you can change CPU power or fan speed in real time.
Notifications keep you posted on scraper progress (media downloads) and Nebula Sync cloud status.
Removes your profile, your cloud saves and your leaderboard entries. This cannot be undone.
